description.id: Tampilan hangat bernuansa krem untuk toko perabot, dapur dan dekorasi rumah: hero dengan produk andalan, belanja per ruangan, promo berhitung mundur, cerita toko, dan checkout satu halaman.
description.en: A warm cream look for furniture, kitchen and home-decor shops: a hero with a featured product, shop-by-room tiles, a countdown sale, the shop's story, and a one-page checkout.
